name: Calendar Themes
install:
set -euo pipefail
export SUPABASE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
export SUPABASE_EXPERIMENTAL_STACK=1
if ! supabase --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qx '3.2.0'; then
  tmp=$(mktemp -d)
  curl -fsSL -o "$tmp/supabase.tar.gz" https://github.com/supabase/cli/releases/download/v3.2.0/supabase_3.2.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
  tar -xzf "$tmp/supabase.tar.gz" -C "$tmp"
  sudo install -m 755 "$tmp/supabase" /usr/local/bin/supabase
  rm -rf "$tmp"
fi
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/calendar-themes' ] || cd '/agent/repos/calendar-themes' || exit $?
npm ci
sudo mkdir -p /opt/caltheme-supabase
sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /opt/caltheme-supabase
if [ ! -f /opt/caltheme-supabase/supabase/config.toml ]; then
  supabase init --workdir /opt/caltheme-supabase
fi
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/opt/caltheme-supabase/supabase/config.toml')
text = p.read_text()
if 'stack = true' not in text:
    needle = '[experimental]\n'
    if needle not in text:
        text += '\n[experimental]\nstack = true\n'
    else:
        text = text.replace(needle, needle + 'stack = true\n', 1)
    p.write_text(text)
PY
if [ ! -f /opt/caltheme-supabase/supabase/supabase.lock ]; then
  supabase stack install --workdir /opt/caltheme-supabase --runtime native
fi
supabase stack install --workdir /opt/caltheme-supabase --frozen --runtime native
